name: Carvana Scraper API
description: Carvana scraper for Python and the command line: used-car inventory by make and model with price, previous price, MSRP, Kelley Blue Book value, mileage, VIN, trim, colours and stock number, as JSON or CSV. Free and open source; sign in with your QuanticData account, no proxies or headless browser to run.

commands.name: search
commands.help: Carvana used-car listings for a make and model
commands.description: Carvana used-car inventory — year/make/model/trim, price, MSRP, mileage, VIN and stock number.

inputs.name: make
inputs.description: Vehicle make, e.g. "Toyota" or "Mercedes-Benz". Omit to browse all inventory.

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many listings to deliver at most (1–96). You pay only for delivered listings.
